title: A chase handed between two discovered attackers is a perpetual chase: the chasing side loses at the third occurrence
rationale: Red's two chariots alternate as the discovered attacker on the unprotected black cannon on b6 — e6 attacks it once the horse vacates c6, b2 once the horse returns to c6 and unblocks the b-file — so every red move renews the attack on one and the same piece from a square that piece was not attacked from before the move. The adopted renewal clause is satisfied word for word by a chariot that never moves: it attacks b6 from the square it now occupies and did not attack it from that square before the move, its own horse having stood in the way. The reading that would call this a neutral repetition is the one that contract names and rejects — that a chase renews only when the threat did not exist anywhere beforehand — and it is worth stating why it lands here: the cannon is attacked at every ply of the cycle, by one chariot or the other, so a test asking only whether the target was already under attack finds nothing new at any move and reads the whole wheel as a repetition nobody made. Black renews nothing. The horse shuttle e4/f6 attacks only empty squares, and the black cannon's own threat on an undefended red chariot — b2 while the horse screens it from b4, e6 while the horse screens it from c6 — is produced by Red's moves and alternates between two different pieces, which is a chase of neither. The cannon is unprotected: the black general stands on d10 and the black horse attacks b6 from neither e4 nor f6. No ply of the cycle gives check to either side and none captures, so nothing short-circuits the chase and nothing resets the ply count. Red therefore loses at the third occurrence of the start position, which stands at plies 0, 4 and 8. Nothing in this line is face down — the record spells it with no `~` at all, which is what a jieqi position with nothing left concealed looks like — and the fixture is jieqi's because jieqi's rules are answered by an engine of its own: mx-chs-033 pins this shape for Mini Xiangqi and pins nothing whatever about this game.
